meta.cluster_format: fs:<FoleySet username>, c3gd:<C3GD platform_id>, esc:<ESC-50 Freesound source id>, hear:<HEAR shot id>
meta.trainable: a FoleySet clip trains or anchors only when foleyset.uploaders[username].pool is train and its split is train (val for early stopping); a C3GD clip only when c3gd.guns[platform_id].pool is train, its mic is DAVE at oh_farm and its split is train (val for early stopping); ESC-50 and HEAR never; train_clips lists the reference-set clips that pass
meta.route_json: a route folder for vocab_eval.py --route NAME=DIR holds <event>-<material>_NN.wav for seeds 00 to 19 at 0.6 or 1.5 s and a route.json with clusters (every source it trained on or anchored from, in cluster_format; empty for none) and optionally sources (file paths), steps, prompts {event|material: prompt} and note; vocab_eval stops when a cluster or file is held out

rules.foleyset: an uploader is held out when FoleySet puts any of its clips in split test, unless it holds more than 12 eligible clips in one reference set (the per-uploader cap of the eval, so the eval could take only 12 of them); a held-out uploader gives every clip to the held-out pool, the rest train on split train; FoleySet holds byte-identical audio under different names, uploaders and sub-categories; a FoleySet reference clip is dropped when its PCM md5 matches a file from an uploader on the training side (held-out builds), a file of another sub-category, or an earlier clip of the same set
rules.c3gd: a gun (platform_id) is held out when it was never recorded on DAVE at oh_farm, or when its position in its form factor's list of guns on that mic, sorted by caliber and platform_id, is a multiple of 2 counting from 0 (a form factor with one gun keeps it for training); a held-out gun gives every clip on every mic to the held-out pool
rules.esc50: CC BY-NC, never trained on; an ESC-50 clip is dropped from the held-out sets when FoleySet names its Freesound uploader on the training side
rules.hear: CC0 far mics, never in the training pool, so all of it is held out

pools.train: training and anchor clips: FoleySet split train from uploaders on the training side, C3GD split train on DAVE at oh_farm from guns on the training side
pools.val: the same sources in FoleySet split val and C3GD split val on DAVE at oh_farm, for early stopping only
pools.heldout: every clip of a held-out source, any split and any mic; the held-out reference sets come only from here
pools.unused: training-side sources outside the two pools above: their FoleySet and C3GD split test clips and their C3GD clips on other mics

meta.thin_rule: fewer than 30 clips or fewer than 8 sources in the built held-out set

surfaces_in_other_footstep_subcategories.note: multi-shot FoleySet recordings outside every reference set; counts by pool and surface from original-tags with the same one-surface rule
